upgradeability.controlRef: GUSD Proxy and Store upgrade custodian (single EOA, no delay)

mintAuthority.summary: GUSD uses Gemini's custom Proxy, Store, implementation, PrintLimiter, and custodian architecture. A limited-printer EOA can mint immediately under the current 1.36 billion GUSD ceiling; a cap custodian EOA can raise or bypass that ceiling, and an upgrade custodian EOA can replace Proxy and Store logic with no delay.

controls.label: GUSD limited-printer EOA
controls.capDescription: PrintLimiter 0x342c1b88c2108f159a4ef37e322b4170b18c42f6 permits this EOA to mint immediately while total supply remains at or below 136,000,000,000 raw units, equal to 1.36 billion GUSD at two decimals. That is more than 33 times cutoff supply, so V9 treats the live path as economically direct even though the EOA cannot raise the ceiling unilaterally.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26307006, PrintLimiter 0x342c1b88c2108f159a4ef37e322b4170b18c42f6 limitedPrinter() returned this EOA, erc20Impl() returned 0x483a1e7f16f46266400f1baf7abdf445c8d140a2, totalSupplyCeiling() returned 136000000000, and custodian() returned EOA 0x57fe1bfffcd7e2211d2b58a9e2a222f43b3ea31b. The limited-printer EOA had no bytecode.

controls.label: GUSD PrintLimiter custodian (EOA)
controls.capDescription: This EOA is custodian of live PrintLimiter 0x342c1b88c2108f159a4ef37e322b4170b18c42f6, so it can immediately raise the ceiling, confirm any print, or replace the implementation custodian.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26307006, ERC20Proxy erc20Impl() = 0x483a1e7f16f46266400f1baf7abdf445c8d140a2 and ERC20Store erc20Impl() matches it; that implementation's custodian() = 0x342c1b88c2108f159a4ef37e322b4170b18c42f6, whose custodian() = 0x57fe1bfffcd7e2211d2b58a9e2a222f43b3ea31b, an address with no bytecode that has itself called confirmSeizureLimitRaise on the PrintLimiter.

controls.label: GUSD Proxy and Store upgrade custodian (single EOA, no delay)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26307006, ERC20Proxy 0x056fd409e1d7a124bd7017459dfea2f387b6d5cd and ERC20Store 0xc42b14e49744538e3c239f8ae48a1eaaf35e68a0 both returned this EOA as custodian and implementation 0x483a1e7f16f46266400f1baf7abdf445c8d140a2, which this EOA confirmed on both at block 26236204. No timelock now stands between a request and an implementation swap.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526129, the complete live graph was ERC20Proxy and ERC20Store -> implementation 0x6704ba24b8640bccee6bf2fd276a6a1b8edf4ade, with both custom upgrade pointers controlled by two-day 2-of-3 custodian 0xb983ed57aeaa180bc7a0078ddadf1ea217f2e421. The implementation's custodian was PrintLimiter 0x72519fa6cd095c99d5d67e31ddc117409bc5c047, whose limited printer was EOA 0xd24400ae8bfebb18ca49be86258a3c749cf46853 under a 136000000000-raw-unit ceiling and whose cap/direct-print custodian was one-hour 2-of-3 contract 0x1789cca7430aacbdb7c89f9b5695a9c06e4764eb. BPM LLP performs monthly independent examinations; the latest reviewed report covers May 29, 2026, was issued June 29, 2026, and fully reconciles GUSD liabilities to reserve assets. The NYDFS registry matches Gemini Trust Company, LLC as a Limited Purpose Trust Charter holder and identifies GUSD as approved for issuance, supporting prudential supervision of the issuer. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the issuer custodian can lift or bypass the print ceiling after one hour, with monthly BPM reconciliation and NYDFS trust supervision retained.
